title: Private console object data
responsibility: Reads console JSON and media from a supplied private object store under one prefix.

inputs.name: consoleStore.bucket
inputs.description: The required private object-store binding used by the JSON and media readers. Its get(key) method returns a promise for a ConsoleObject or null; found objects provide asynchronous text and byte readers.

inputs.name: consoleStore.prefix
inputs.description: An optional key prefix prepended to the requested JSON path or media key. Defaults to the empty string; trailing slashes are removed, and an empty prefix leaves keys unprefixed.

outputs.name: consoleStore
outputs.description: Returns an object with async json(path) and media(name) readers that use the configured prefix after removing its trailing slashes. JSON yields stored text or undefined when missing; media yields bytes and a MIME type selected from the case-sensitive png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif, wav, mp3, m4a, ogg, mp4, and webm extensions, using application/octet-stream for other extensions, or undefined when missing.

errors.name: Underlying storage rejection
errors.description: A rejection from ConsoleBucket.get, ConsoleObject.text, or ConsoleObject.arrayBuffer propagates from the async reader; this unit does not assign it a stable error name or translate it.
